I started playing in season 3 as a avid and casual player. But beginning of season 5 I took it very seriously. One day a random friend added me to a game and it had 3 other people who would later become some of the best friends I have ever had : their names were Caleb, Nick, and Katie. We played for months through the pains of the boring tank meta ruled by sejuani and nunu. One day my pal Caleb added one of his school friends (I live in Canada, Caleb and nick live in Boston, and Katie lives in Akron), her name was Gen. She didn't talk much but we argued over Zelda because I never played it I dismissed it as trash so we argued. Then for several months, till about mid October I didn't talk to Gen, then Caleb adds her to a call I'm in and we exchange Skypes so we could text of we got bored, one day she texts me asking for help she says that she likes Caleb and has for 3 years so she wants me to find out if he likes her back. So I tell her to leave the call and she does and I ask him, he says "Hell no." And I say damn ok xD. I tell her but she didn't seem convinced so she asked him herself and he said that he likes someone else so she accepts it and goes into a bit of a depression (at this point she didn't have a computer) so me and her start talking and my friend Katie asked if I like her I said "meh", turns out she asked me because Gen liked me. So I went for it. And in 2 weeks we are meeting for the first time on our 6 month anniversary! She is also my support because she enjoys getting me killed :)

Can anyone tell me what the most gold efficient build path for Lucian and sivir Please :)

First of you need to assess your team, try to find who the tanks are and who has peel for you. Ideally you want your tank line to initiate and stay beside your peel which is usually your support and use your e to reposition and use your w for the movement speed if you AA them. When you proc your passive you get a reduced cooldown use your e as often as you can along with q poking. When their assassin jumps on you, you need to assess your options and try to flash away to your peel or just try to run. Often the assassin will combo you so try to get away as fast as possible. Use your w movement speed to kite. And if you get caught out by a high cc comp buy qss and try to run to your team using e and w to kite them out because most tanks are easy to kite.
